functions.name: run_strategic_scan
functions.title: Run Strategic Analytics Skip-Trace
functions.description: Searches all connected analytics accounts (Google Analytics, Search Console), auto-detects businesses, fetches metrics, finds performance gaps, and returns AI-generated recommendations on how to close each gap. Call when the user asks for a gap analysis, performance audit, or strategic scan of their businesses.

business_id.description: Optional. Limit the scan to a single business by its ID. Omit to scan all businesses.

force_refresh.description: If true, re-fetches fresh data even if a recent snapshot exists. Defaults to false.
